mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic and CNS depressant properties; escitalopram has mild serotonergic activity while meclizine has H1-antagonist and anticholinergic effects, leading to additive CNS depression and anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor for increased sedation, dizziness, and anticholinergic symptoms; counsel patient on avoiding activities requiring alertness; consider dose adjustment if excessive CNS depression occurs.
